main.description: Lists who belongs to a thread: the author of the message it was opened from, everyone who has posted in it, everyone mentioned in it directly or through a role, and everyone who follows it. Only current members who may read the thread are listed.

thread.description: The thread to list members of.

members.description: The thread's members: the anchor author first, then posters by most recent activity, then everyone else.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user may not read this thread.

errors.name: ThreadNotFound
errors.description: No thread matches the given space reference.
